scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.db:apply: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply content-share-db --remote
scripts.db:migrate: npx wrangler d1 migrations apply content-share-db --remote
scripts.r2:cors: npx wrangler r2 bucket cors set content-share-save --file=./r2-cors.json
scripts.r2:local-uploads: npx wrangler r2 bucket local-uploads enable content-share-save
scripts.r2:notify: npx wrangler r2 bucket notification create content-share-save --event-type object-create --queue content-share-upload-queue --prefix attachments/
scripts.r2:lifecycle: npx wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add content-share-save abort-incomplete-direct-uploads attachments --abort-multipart-days 1 --force
scripts.r2:staging-lifecycle: npx wrangler r2 bucket lifecycle add content-share-save expire-abandoned-single-uploads upload-staging --expire-days 1 --force
